name: Wounds Transference
body:
School necromancy; Level antipaladin 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (A small eye agate worth at least 10 gp.)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target living creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

If you are currently wounded, you may transfer your wounds to a living creature you touch. The target takes damage equal 1 point per caster level to a maximum of your unhealed total hit point damage. You are healed by the same amount of damage.
